description: An abstract class defining the structure and core methods for implementing calendar provider plugins within the SuiteCRM system. Contains method signatures for handling calendar events, connection testing, and event synchronization, meant to be extended for specific calendar integrations.

classes.name: AbstractCalendarProvider
classes.description: Defines the abstract base for calendar providers including methods for testing connections, managing events, and synchronization workflows. Designed to be extended with provider-specific functionality.

methods.name: setConnection
methods.description: Assigns a CalendarAccount connection object to this provider.

methods.name: testCalendarConnection
methods.description: Abstract method to verify the connection to the calendar service.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Abstract method to fetch calendar events based on a query.

methods.name: createEventFromSource
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event from a source event, generating an event ID, and calling the internal creation logic.

methods.name: generateEventId
methods.description: Internal helper to generate unique event identifiers.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Commits a new event to the calendar provider and sets the last sync timestamp.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Abstract method for provider-specific event creation implementation.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a specific event based on its target ID.

methods.name: updateEventFromSource
methods.description: Updates an existing event based on a source event, using the event factory to prepare the target event.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Internal method to set the last sync timestamp and delegate to provider-specific update logic.

methods.name: doUpdateEvent
methods.description: Abstract method for provider-specific event update logic.

methods.name: updateSourceEvent
methods.description: Links a target event ID into a source event and updates the event accordingly.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Template method for deleting an event, delegates to provider-specific implementation.

methods.name: doDeleteEvent
methods.description: Abstract method for the provider-specific deletion logic.

methods.name: getExternalCalendarName
methods.description: Fetches the external calendar name from configuration, with a default fallback.
